# GemCore

> Real CAD rings from a conversation: exact geometry, exact finger sizes, automatic checks, STL and STEP export.

Made by Monili VLR (https://monili-vlr.github.io/). How to get it: A plugin (MCP app) for ChatGPT and Codex, in early access. Ask for access through the Monili VLR contact form.
Works in: ChatGPT, Codex. Example of what you write: "Design a size 14 ring with a twisted band."

## Tools the AI can call (56)

### Start a new piece

- `show_gemcore_welcome`: Welcome panel: carousel, benchmarks and limits.
- `list_ring_typologies`: The catalogue: the first step of every new ring.
- `start_ring_typology`: Builds the base of a catalogue piece as a new project.
- `list_jewelry_templates`: Parametric templates and their parameters.
- `get_template_parameters`: Parametric templates and their parameters.
- `create_jewelry_spec`: Reproduce an existing JewelrySpec and generate it.
- `validate_jewelry_spec`: Reproduce an existing JewelrySpec and generate it.
- `generate_jewelry`: Reproduce an existing JewelrySpec and generate it.

### Change the piece

- `modify_jewelry`: Incremental change by parameters or simple words.
- `apply_design_operations`: A list of vocabulary operations as one revision.
- `get_design_vocabulary`: A list of vocabulary operations as one revision.
- `apply_style`: A catalogue style: split shank, cathedral, bezel…
- `get_ring_shape`: The ring’s shape with a jeweller’s handles.
- `set_ring_shape`: The ring’s shape with a jeweller’s handles.
- `move_part`: Free-form pieces: move parts, edit by points.
- `rebuild_with_handles`: Free-form pieces: move parts, edit by points.
- `get_freeform_program`: Free-form pieces: move parts, edit by points.

### Stones, surface, details

- `get_pave`: Painted stones and beads.
- `edit_pave`: Painted stones and beads.
- `get_rope_contours`: Ropes and braids along an edge.
- `make_rope`: Ropes and braids along an edge.
- `get_ring_lines`: Grooves and ribs along the piece.
- `set_ring_lines`: Grooves and ribs along the piece.
- `hammer_finish`: Hammered texture; scrolls on the shoulders.
- `engrave_scrolls`: Hammered texture; scrolls on the shoulders.
- `engraving_sheet_prompt`: Engraving from a photo, in two steps.
- `engrave_from_sheet`: Engraving from a photo, in two steps.

### References and look

- `analyze_reference`: “Make it like this photo”, then compare from the same side.
- `compare_with_reference`: “Make it like this photo”, then compare from the same side.
- `import_mesh_reference`: A mesh made elsewhere as a reference.
- `set_look`: Look and render in words; the 3D viewer; the user’s pen sketch.
- `show_jewelry_viewer`: Look and render in words; the 3D viewer; the user’s pen sketch.
- `get_annotation`: Look and render in words; the 3D viewer; the user’s pen sketch.

### Checks, history, export

- `get_model_status`: Three validation states; technical sheet for the jeweller.
- `get_validation_report`: Three validation states; technical sheet for the jeweller.
- `get_tech_sheet`: Three validation states; technical sheet for the jeweller.
- `list_revisions`: Immutable revisions.
- `restore_revision`: Immutable revisions.
- `compare_revisions`: Immutable revisions.
- `export_stl`: STL (metal + separate stones) and STEP (assembly, mm).
- `export_step`: STL (metal + separate stones) and STEP (assembly, mm).
- `wait_for_job`: Waits for long builds.

### Help inside the chat

- `propose_editor`: Yes/No to open a panel; interpreter card; link to this site.
- `show_interpretation`: Yes/No to open a panel; interpreter card; link to this site.
- `show_gemcore_page_button`: Yes/No to open a panel; interpreter card; link to this site.
- `get_gemcore_page`: Yes/No to open a panel; interpreter card; link to this site.
- `find_command`: Command database, spoken tutorials, user preferences.
- `tutorial_chapter`: Command database, spoken tutorials, user preferences.
- `tutorial_search`: Command database, spoken tutorials, user preferences.
- `get_gemcore_preferences`: Command database, spoken tutorials, user preferences.

### ChatGPT plugin server

- `create_ring_design`: Create, change, undo and show a ring in 3D.
- `modify_ring_design`: Create, change, undo and show a ring in 3D.
- `undo_ring_change`: Create, change, undo and show a ring in 3D.
- `show_ring_design`: Create, change, undo and show a ring in 3D.
- `quote_wax_print`: Wax-print quote and order page (ready in the code, not live).
- `start_wax_print_order`: Wax-print quote and order page (ready in the code, not live).

Plus 49 internal tools used only by the product's own panel, not called by the AI.
